article.title: Profound接入Teams，把AI搜尋分析帶進團隊對話
article.summary: Profound推出Teams及Microsoft 365整合，讓團隊在對話中查詢品牌的AI搜尋能見度、準確度及引用份額。
highlights: 在Teams提及Profound，可提出問題、建立代理或啟動Profound Project。
Teams版本現供有有效Profound訂閱的客戶使用。
article.why: AI搜尋問題可直接在協作對話中轉成分析工作，團隊可決定哪些能見度異常值得建立專案跟進。
article.next_step: 挑選一項引用份額變動，在Teams追問原因並建立專案，再比對回傳內容與Profound的原始資料。
article.detail: Profound表示，Microsoft 365整合可從SharePoint及OneDrive讀取文件，並建立或編輯Word和Excel檔案。系統亦可把選定內容帶入知識庫。行銷團隊可以從一個明確的AI搜尋問題開始，保留對話、來源與後續專案的連結，檢查資訊是否足以支持下一項內容調整。
article.title_en: Profound brings AI search analysis into Teams conversations
article.summary_en: Profound launched Teams and Microsoft 365 integrations for questions about AI search visibility, accuracy and citation share.
highlights_en: Mentioning Profound in Teams can start questions, agents or a Profound Project.
The Teams integration is available to customers with an active Profound subscription.
article.why_en: Teams can turn a visibility anomaly discussed in chat into a defined analysis project.
article.next_step_en: Investigate one citation-share change in Teams, start a project and compare its answers with Profound's underlying data.
article.detail_en: Profound says Microsoft 365 connections can read SharePoint and OneDrive files and create or edit Word and Excel documents. Selected content can enter a knowledge base. Keep the conversation, source and project linked when assessing a proposed content change.
